usage: agentbreeder agent set-ref [-h] [--project DIR]
                                  [--dry-run | --expect-base SHA256] [--json]
                                  OLD NEW

Replace OLD with NEW in DIR/agent.yaml: OLD must be a ref field's value and
occur once in the file; NEW must be the same kind and resolve. Then build and
release.

positional arguments:
  OLD                   kind/name@X.Y.Z the agent uses now
  NEW                   kind/name@X.Y.Z to use instead

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR
  --dry-run             Show the diff; write nothing
  --expect-base SHA256  Refuse unless agent.yaml is still this digest (from
                        --dry-run)
  --json
